description: Seeded MULTI-LOCATION bugs in the ShopCart app: every bug needs changes in two definitions (same file, two files, or code + constant). Fixing only one place leaves the hidden oracle failing. Built by build.py from ../shopcart/app.

bugs.title: Orders exactly at the discount and free-shipping limits are treated wrongly
bugs.body:
The store promises a 10% discount for orders of Rs 1,000 or more, and free shipping for orders of Rs 500 or more.
But the limits themselves are excluded:
1. An order of exactly Rs 1,000 gets no discount. Expected: discount Rs 100. Actual: discount Rs 0.
2. The shipping fee for an amount of exactly Rs 500 is Rs 50. Expected: free shipping (Rs 0). Actual: Rs 50.
Both checks seem to use the wrong comparison.

mutations.old:
if quantity <= 0:
            raise ValueError("quantity must be positive")
mutations.new:
if quantity < 0:
            raise ValueError("quantity must be positive")

mutations.old:
if quantity < 0:
            raise ValueError("quantity cannot be negative")

bugs.title: Cart accepts invalid quantities
bugs.body:
The cart silently accepts quantities that make no sense.
1. cart.add(product, 0) adds the product with quantity 0. Expected: ValueError, because the quantity must be positive.
2. cart.set_quantity(sku, -2) on an item in the cart sets its quantity to -2. Expected: ValueError, because a quantity cannot be negative.
Negative or zero quantities later produce wrong totals at checkout.

bugs.kind: caller in cart.py + constant in pricing.py
bugs.title: Shipping charges are wrong
bugs.body:
Shipping is a flat Rs 50, free when the amount payable (after discounts and coupons) is Rs 500 or more.
1. A Rs 300 order (one product of Rs 300) is charged Rs 40 shipping. Expected: Rs 50.
2. A Rs 520 order (one product of Rs 520) with coupon SAVE10 pays Rs 468 after the coupon, so it should be charged Rs 50 shipping. Actual: shipping is free (Rs 0); free shipping seems to be decided on the amount before the coupon.

bugs.kind: function in pricing.py + caller in cart.py
bugs.title: Coupon problems: codes with spaces rejected, coupon computed on the wrong amount
bugs.body:
Coupon codes are documented as case-insensitive and ignoring surrounding spaces, and the coupon applies to the amount after the bulk discount.
1. cart.apply_coupon(' save10 ') (with spaces) returns False. Expected: True (it is the SAVE10 coupon).
2. A Rs 2,000 order (one product of Rs 2,000) with coupon SAVE10: the bulk discount is Rs 200, so the coupon should be 10% of Rs 1,800 = Rs 180. Actual: coupon Rs 200 (computed on the amount before the discount).

bugs.kind: constant in pricing.py + caller in cart.py (one symptom, two causes)
bugs.title: GST on the bill is wrong
bugs.body:
GST must be 18% of the amount after discounts and coupons.
Steps: add one product of Rs 1,000 to the cart and check out. The 10% bulk discount gives Rs 900 taxable.
Expected: tax = 18% of Rs 900 = Rs 162.00.
Actual: tax = Rs 120.00.
We suspect both the GST rate and the amount it is applied to are wrong.
